title: Inertia
coreMove: Identify what is already moving, then decide whether to interrupt, redirect, or use its momentum.
sourcePressure: Inertia concerns people and systems continuing in their current direction unless a meaningful force changes the path.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: making the lesson a generic motivation speech about getting started

hook: opening with a definition of Inertia
counterintuition: making the lesson a generic motivation speech about getting started
tryThisNow: set a timer and think about it
audit your life with no chapter-specific object
examples: same dashboard meeting with swapped names
kitchen-table family argument unless the domain requires it
teacher and student scene used as default proof

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'

tryThisNowSpec: In the next decision involving inertia, write one sentence naming the concrete force, constraint, or condition from this model, then change one visible action before the moment passes. Keep it under 90 seconds.
